body.statement: In the no-selection randomized experimental response-type model with positive observed cells, \(W\perp Z\mid U\), and Conditions (1)--(3) of Shingaki--Kuroki (2023), the four response-type probabilities are identified.  Their equations (8)--(13) give plug-in estimators of those probabilities, and their asymptotic-normality result implies consistency whenever the empirical cell probabilities obey the multinomial law of large numbers.

source.locator: Theorem 1 and equations (8)--(13), pages 12289--12291; Theorem 2, pages 12290--12291
